text: [64ffff]Entered the waiting room for final battle.
[ff6464]If you leave the venue, you'll be counted as\ndropping out of the challenge and you'll need\nto pay the items to try again![ffffff] Okay??
Alright! Now you're a fireball that breaks down\nthe thick wall!! Fire up! Fire up your blood\nand show your true self to the Sun!!
There will be 5 boss battles in the event.
The difficulty is extremely high so we recommend\nthat you [64ffff]challenge in a full party[ffffff].
If you leave the venue halfway or fall out of the\nring, you need to [ff6464]start all over again[ffffff].
The payment of the participation fee(items) will\nbe made after after winning the first battle.
The difficulty is extremely high so we recommend\nthat you [64ffff]challenge in a full party[ffffff].
Hey, you! Are you doing your best? ...I see.\nBut you can't win just by doing your best!\nThen, what to do, you ask? Break through the wall!
Hey, you! It's really nice to see you again!!\nBut I'm way stronger than what I used to be!\nCuz I always have walls to break down!
The annual competition is still a way off...\nI won't just stand and wait for the wall coming\nto me! I'll create walls by myself!!
It's not really big like the annual competition\nbut you can challenge 5 monsters. [ffff64]You can get\na reward everytime you win a battle[ffffff].
If the summer wasn't hot, you'd feel it isn't\nenough. You can't see your true self without\nenough heat in your life! Now fire up your blood!
Giving up already before hitting the wall?!\nNo! No! No! Do not give up!\nFire up yourself!!
Why what? Raise your fighting spirit!\nFire up your soul! You can find your true self\nonly when your soul is on fire!
No, I really don't want that.
How dare you spoil yourself?!\nYou don't even try to break through the wall!\nYou apathetic adventurer!
That's the spirit! First of all, can you go [ffff64]get\nthe participation fee[ffffff]. Huh? No, it's not free.\nBut you know I'm not doing this for money!
Unlike the fighting competition, I'm personally\nhosting the event. It costs a lot and I want only\nthe soldiers who can collect the fee easily.
You said you fire up your life, right?\nYou said you fire up your blood, huh?!\nNow, overcome the trial and show me your heat!
Greeaat!! It's hot! It's getting exciting!!\nThese are the items needed as the participation\nfee!
Megiston gave you a paper on which the numbers\nand types of items are written.
Congrats!! You fought more intently than any other\nsoldiers! The time you fought without thinking\nabout future nor past brought you the victory!!
I'll give it to you for your fighting spirit.\nFire up more! Fire up your blood! You can find\nyour true self only when your soul is on fire!
CHALLENGE BATTLE\nDefeat Ferzen the Rock Dragon!!
CHALLENGE BATTLE\nCalm both of them down...
